comparison.claim_scope: Cross-domain smoke only; not a full method claim.

main_findings: Style repair fixed evidence-caption shape: generated qcond/no-question evidence_shape_rate reached 1.0 and answer_label_only_rate reached 0.0.
Semantic QA did not improve for qcond: v2 and v2.1 are both 0.3143, so output form was not the main accuracy bottleneck.
qconditioning gap increased to +0.2000 because no-question accuracy dropped to 0.1143 while qcond stayed flat.
Grid2Op qcond accuracy dropped from 0.3000 to 0.0000 due to wrong numeric grounding in long-window and counterfactual tasks.
Traffic, Water, and AIOps improved under qcond, suggesting the cleaner template helps shorter/simpler domain templates but hurts Grid2Op memorization/generalization.
recommended_next_step: Do not scale this template blindly. Add numeric-grounding diagnostics and per-domain templates, especially for Grid2Op long-window/counterfactual tasks; consider value-copy/slot-supervision rather than only style repair.
